notes.title: The Footsy Demo is Here – Play Now During Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes:
[h2]It’s finally here! The demo for [b]Footsy[/b] is now live as part of [b]Steam Next Fest[/b] 🎉
[/h2][p]Grab a friend, clear some space in grandma’s living room, and dive into chaotic soccer mayhem! The demo is [b]local multiplayer only[/b], but you can still play online with friends using [b]Steam Remote Play[/b]! perfect for long-distance rivalries.[/p][p][/p][p]We’d [i]love[/i] for you to check it out and hear what you think! Your feedback means the world to us and helps make Footsy even better. Drop your thoughts here: [/p][p][url="https://forms.gle/uk6azAN4DywAsfd79"]https://forms.gle/uk6azAN4DywAsfd79[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Don’t forget to [b]wishlist Footsy[/b] to stay in the loop for updates, future demos, and the official release date 💥[/p][p]Thanks so much for being a part of this journey with us. and we hope you enjoy the demo![/p][p]- Tim, JamPics[/p][p][/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: The Footsy Reveal Trailer is Here! 🎥⚽
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=mnpfmswip_0;full][/previewyoutube]

After a long journey of development, we’re thrilled to finally share the reveal trailer for Footsy!

Footsy is a chaotic multiplayer soccer party game set inside grandma's house! Smash furniture, shatter bottles, and tumble TVs as you compete in wild, goal-scoring action. Customize your characters, challenge your friends, and make every room look like a battlefield!

Don’t forget to wishlist Footsy now to stay updated on future announcements, Demo releases, and our release date. Your support means everything to us <3

Thank you for being part of this journey. We can’t wait to hear your thoughts! watch the trailer and let us know what you think in the comments!

- Tim, JamPics
